title: [FEATURE] Opusplan[1m] for using opus for planning, and sonnet[1m] together
body:
### Preflight Checklist

### Problem Statement

I currently use `opusplan` as a model, but I'm not sure if theres anyway to configure the sonnet use to use sonnet[1m] instead of the default sonnet. 

### Proposed Solution

Can we configure a mode for opusplan[1m] to use sonnet[1m] when not using plan mode?
